investigation: All three Sky arms exceeded 8.33 ms under shared load at the same 2560 × 1440 view with capture off. Trace and compose dominate. All visible arms trace 921,600 half-extent pixels and use 122,173,520 bytes. The overcast trace visited 7.4% as many samples as fair and spent 44% as long. The counter counts empty travel but leaves out nested solar-light steps. The closed deck reaches opacity quickly but performs lighting at most contributing visits. Overcast resolve took 0.207 ms against fair's 0.141 ms. Its dispatch size stays fixed, while more covered pixels can reach the reprojection and old-front branch. A shared-load take cannot separate that branch from contention. Earlier takes tripped different small passes, including the weather map and hemisphere light. Those did not recur at the 25% threshold in this pair. Retain the named passes, samples and load for whole-frame tuning.
estimates: CLOUDS DESIGN cost account: weather <0.1 ms, Sun 0.1–0.2 ms, ground <0.05 ms; profiles and resource bytes recorded separately.
